note: Both sets capture the core facts (first floor at 2'-4" above grade, 2"x8" frame/joist, 3/8"x4" hex bolts, 8D ring-shank nails @ 6" O.C., 3/4" exterior plywood, plate with 7/16" holes @ 12" O.C., continuous waterproofing, Clearvue cable railing). Set A adds several unsupported or misbound claims — 5'-2 1/2" labeled as 'railing post spacing', a bracket 'connection to joist/frame' and 'installed' status not in the quote, 3/4" called deck thickness when the quote is plywood, and 1'-4 3/4" given an invented 'center to center' condition — plus heavy duplication (frame size three times, grade level twice) and a trivial self-referential claim. Set B also errs (W10x15 folded into 'steel decking', 1'-4 3/4" attributed to the RAILING ATTACHMENT/C1 detail when it is a module-connection dimension, the garbled 'ank nail' claim, and an invented 'between connection points' condition on 8'-0"), but it adds genuinely distinct supported facts A misses: continuous sealant each side of framing as recommended by manufacturer, W10x15 structural member, 2"x8" joist, and adjustable scaffold footing. Net, B has slightly fewer misread/misbound claims and less duplication, so it is the better set.
